chart.title: Mortality per weekly age
chart.dataset: SELECT t.weekly_age, SUM(t.mortality) AS _total_mortality, bs.reference as breeding_shed_ref FROM pf_start_technical_sheet t inner join pf_breeding_shed bs on bs.id = t.breeding_shed and bs.current_batch_number = t.tracking_number where ( t.center = :vCenter) and ( :vBreedingShed = 0 or t.breeding_shed = :vBreedingShed ) group by t.weekly_age, bs.reference ORDER BY t.weekly_age;

chart.name: flesh.technical.sheet.line.temp.per.daily.age
chart.title: Temperature by chick per daily age
chart.dataset:
SELECT rq.daily_age, rq.series_key, rq.temperature FROM ( SELECT pts.daily_age, bs.reference AS breeding_shed_ref, 'min' AS temp_type, t.temperature_min AS temperature, CONCAT('min_', bs.reference) AS series_key FROM pf_technical_sheet_line t INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs ON bs.id = t.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_technical_sheet pts ON pts.id = t.technical_sheet AND bs.current_batch_number = pts.tracking_number WHERE (pts.center = :vCenter) and (:vBreedingShed = 0 or t.breeding_shed = :vBreedingShed)
UNION
SELECT pts1.daily_age, bs1.reference AS breeding_shed_ref, 'max' AS temp_type, t1.temperature_max AS temperature, CONCAT('max_', bs1.reference) AS series_key FROM pf_technical_sheet_line t1 INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs1 ON bs1.id = t1.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_technical_sheet pts1 ON pts1.id = t1.technical_sheet AND bs1.current_batch_number = pts1.tracking_number WHERE (bs1.center = :vCenter) and (:vBreedingShed = 0 or bs1.id = :vBreedingShed)
UNION
SELECT pts2.daily_age, 'common_consg' AS breeding_shed_ref, 'consg' AS temp_type, MIN(t2.temperature_consg) AS temperature, 'consg' AS series_key FROM pf_technical_sheet_line t2 INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs2 ON bs2.id = t2.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_technical_sheet pts2 ON pts2.id = t2.technical_sheet AND bs2.current_batch_number = pts2.tracking_number WHERE (bs2.center = :vCenter) and (:vBreedingShed = 0 or bs2.id = :vBreedingShed) GROUP BY pts2.daily_age ) rq ORDER BY rq.daily_age, rq.series_key;

chart.name: maintenance.energy.consumption.per.date
chart.title: Total energy consumption per date
chart.dataset: SELECT m.date_time as "date_time", p."name" as "product" , SUM(qty) AS total_quantity FROM pf_maintenance_energy_consumption m inner join base_product p on p.id = m.product WHERE --(:vSelectedDate IS NULL OR CAST(m.date_time AS DATE) = CAST(:vSelectedDate AS DATE)) --AND (:vProduct IS NULL OR m.product = :vProduct) (:vProduct IS NULL OR m.product = :vProduct) GROUP BY p."name" , m.date_time ORDER BY m.date_time;

chart.name: principal.dashboard.percentage.he.per.center
chart.title: Percentage HE per center
chart.dataset:
SELECT pc."name" AS center_name, SUM(t.received_number_of_he) AS total_he, (SUM(t.received_number_of_he) * 100.0 / total_he.total_he_all_centers) AS percentage_of_he FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs ON bs.id = t.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception INNER JOIN pf_center pc ON bs.center = pc.id INNER JOIN (SELECT SUM(t.received_number_of_he) AS total_he_all_centers FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs ON bs.id = t.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception WHERE pts.status = 2) AS total_he ON 1=1
WHERE pts.status = 2 GROUP BY pc."name", total_he.total_he_all_centers;

chart.name: principal.dashboard.percentage.dye.per.center
chart.title: Percentage DYE per center
chart.dataset:
SELECT pc."name" AS center_name, SUM(t.received_number_of_dye) AS total_dye, (SUM(t.received_number_of_dye) * 100.0 / total_dye.total_dye_all_centers) AS percentage_of_dye FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs ON bs.id = t.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception INNER JOIN pf_center pc ON bs.center = pc.id
INNER JOIN (SELECT SUM(t.received_number_of_dye) AS total_dye_all_centers FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs ON bs.id = t.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception WHERE pts.status = 2) AS total_dye ON 1=1 WHERE pts.status = 2 GROUP BY pc."name", total_dye.total_dye_all_centers;

chart.name: principal.dashboard.percentage.de.per.tracking.number.and.center
chart.title: Percentage HE per tracking number/center
chart.dataset: SELECT pc."name" AS center_name, stn.tracking_number_seq as tracking_number, CONCAT(pc."name", ' - ', stn.tracking_number_seq) AS complete_key, SUM(t.received_number_of_he) AS total_he, (SUM(t.received_number_of_he) * 100.0 / total_he.total_he_all_centers) AS percentage_of_he FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs ON bs.id = t.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception INNER JOIN pf_center pc ON bs.center = pc.id INNER JOIN stock_tracking_number stn ON pts.tracking_number = stn.id INNER JOIN (SELECT SUM(t.received_number_of_he) AS total_he_all_centers FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_breeding_shed bs ON bs.id = t.breeding_shed INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception WHERE pts.status = 2) AS total_he ON 1=1 WHERE pts.status = 2 GROUP BY pc."name", stn.tracking_number_seq, total_he.total_he_all_centers;

chart.name: principal.dashboard.percentage.he.dye.de
chart.title: Percentage HE per tracking number/center
chart.dataset:
SELECT 'HE' AS label, (SUM(t.received_number_of_he) * 100.0 / (SUM(t.received_number_of_he) + SUM(t.received_number_of_dye) + SUM(t.received_number_of_de))) AS value FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception WHERE pts.status = 2 GROUP BY label
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DYE' AS label, (SUM(t.received_number_of_dye) * 100.0 / (SUM(t.received_number_of_he) + SUM(t.received_number_of_dye) + SUM(t.received_number_of_de))) AS value FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception WHERE pts.status = 2 GROUP BY label
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DE' AS label, (SUM(t.received_number_of_de) * 100.0 / (SUM(t.received_number_of_he) + SUM(t.received_number_of_dye) + SUM(t.received_number_of_de))) AS value FROM pf_hatchery_eggs_reception_line t INNER JOIN pf_hatchery_eggs_reception pts ON pts.id = t.eggs_reception WHERE pts.status = 2 GROUP BY label;

chart.name: principal.dashboard.chicks.qty
chart.title: Total, sold and installed quantity
chart.dataset:
SELECT phe.datetime AS _date, phe.extern_number AS _value, 'Quantity Sold' AS series_key FROM pf_hatcher_exit phe WHERE phe.status = 2 group by phe.extern_number, phe.datetime
UNION
SELECT phe.datetime AS _date, SUM(phe.extern_number + phe.intern_number) AS _value, 'Total Produced Quantity' AS series_key FROM pf_hatcher_exit phe WHERE phe.status = 2 group by phe.datetime
UNION
SELECT phe.datetime AS _date, phe.intern_number AS _value, 'Quantity Installed' AS series_key FROM pf_hatcher_exit phe WHERE phe.status = 2 group by phe.intern_number, phe.datetime;

chart.name: principal.dashboard.flesh.chicks.average.weight
chart.title: Chicks slaughtered / Average weight
chart.dataset: SELECT pc."name" AS _center, SUM(per._value) AS _value, 'Total chicks' AS series_key FROM (SELECT center, SUM(female_reform_number + male_reform_number) AS _value FROM pf_elev_reform WHERE destination = 1 AND slaughterhouse IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 GROUP BY center ) AS per INNER JOIN pf_center pc ON per.center = pc.id GROUP BY pc."name" union SELECT pc."name" AS _center, per.avg_value as _value, 'Average weight' AS series_key FROM (SELECT center, AVG(male_average_weight + female_average_weight) / 2 AS avg_value FROM pf_elev_reform WHERE destination = 1 AND slaughterhouse IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 GROUP BY center ) AS per INNER JOIN pf_center pc ON per.center = pc.id GROUP BY pc."name",per.avg_value;

chart.name: principal.dashboard.flesh.chicks.global.weight
chart.title: Chicks slaughtered / Global weight
chart.dataset: SELECT pc."name" AS _center, SUM(per._value) AS _value, 'Total chicks' AS series_key FROM (SELECT center, SUM(female_reform_number + male_reform_number) AS _value FROM pf_elev_reform WHERE destination = 1 AND slaughterhouse IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 GROUP BY center ) AS per INNER JOIN pf_center pc ON per.center = pc.id GROUP BY pc."name" union SELECT pc."name" AS _center, per.global_weight as _value, 'Global weight' AS series_key FROM (SELECT center, AVG(male_average_weight + female_average_weight) AS global_weight FROM pf_elev_reform WHERE destination = 1 AND slaughterhouse IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 GROUP BY center ) AS per INNER JOIN pf_center pc ON per.center = pc.id GROUP BY pc."name",per.global_weight;
